edited_fraction: 8,512 entries (Fable 5.1) on Qwen2.5-0.5B; on 7B-14B targets updates grew from 29K to 7.06B parameters
cost_reported: yes: ~$779 API cost for 224 editor runs (~$1 per GPT-6 Astra run vs $4-7 for others), per-run wall-clock minutes reported; gradient baselines not costed in $
evidence_notes: Editors call a single python tool on a persistent kernel holding the target, with a 50-forward-pass budget (p3, p13-14), so closed-loop and tool-mediated; targets reach Qwen2.5-14B (p7). 16-shot ICL (inference-only) and Adam/LoRA/rank-1/context-distillation match the editors, and edits fail under new prompt wordings (p5, p8); unfinished runs and provider-side filtering are reported (p7, p9). Open-weight GLM-5.2 averaged 5.2% and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 73.9% vs ~90% for frontier editors (Table 20, p23); an LLM annotated strategies and assisted with code (p10); results 'will be released' on GitHub (p2); no preregistration.
